properties.description: The served design-a-phenomenon skill (2026-10-27, from the sinogram trial): the observation given; the model and each law used as given taken up with held_as model / principle; each idealization its own premise with where it fails; a step per prediction and one per dropped idealization; the hypothesis under test a supposition discharged into the prediction stated before the data; every number through a kept calculator record (none claimed without one); experiments chosen to discriminate and accepted before the data; a result as evidence that supports or contests; a read-back, and what the structure gives a journal article.
